tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Get recent console output. Filter by level or search text.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return

since.description: Only return entries after this Unix timestamp (ms). Pass the timestamp of the last seen entry to fetch only new ones.

summary.description: Return a one-line summary with counts

device.description: Device key or "all" for aggregated logs. Defaults to current device.

format.description: Return 'json' for a structured array of log entries

tools.name: clear_console_logs
tools.description: Clear the console log buffer.

device.description: Device key to clear, or omit for current device. Use "all" to clear all.

tools.name: get_network_requests
tools.description: Get recent network requests from the React Native app.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return

since.description: Only return requests after this Unix timestamp (ms). Pass the timestamp of the last seen entry to fetch only new ones.

summary.description: Return a one-line summary with counts

device.description: Device key or "all" for aggregated requests. Defaults to current device.

format.description: Return 'json' for a structured array of request objects

tools.name: get_request_details
tools.description: Get full details of a specific network request including headers and body.

url.description: URL or partial URL to find the request

index.description: Index of the request if multiple match (-1 for last)

device.description: Device key or "all". Defaults to current device.

tools.name: get_response_body
tools.description: Get response body for a network request (cached if small; requires active session if large).

url.description: URL or partial URL to find the request

index.description: Index of the request if multiple match (-1 for last)

device.description: Device key or "all". Defaults to current device.

tools.name: search_network
tools.description: Search network requests by URL pattern, method, or status code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

device.description: Device key or "all". Defaults to current device.

tools.name: clear_network_requests
tools.description: Clear the network request buffer.

device.description: Device key to clear, or omit for current device. Use "all" to clear all.

tools.name: get_network_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated network statistics: breakdown by domain, status code, and response times.

device.description: Device key or "all". Defaults to current device.

tools.name: get_errors
tools.description: Get recent uncaught exceptions from the React Native app.

limit.description: Maximum number of errors to return

since.description: Only return entries after this Unix timestamp (ms). Pass the timestamp of the last seen entry to fetch only new ones.

summary.description: Return a one-line summary with counts

device.description: Device key or "all" for aggregated errors. Defaults to current device.

format.description: Return 'json' for a structured array of error entries

tools.name: clear_errors
tools.description: Clear the error buffer.

device.description: Device key to clear, or omit for current device. Use "all" to clear all.

tools.name: get_bundle_errors
tools.description: Get recent Metro compilation/transform errors.

tools.name: evaluate_js
tools.description: Execute a JavaScript expression in the running React Native app and return the result. Use this for inspecting variables, calling functions, or querying app state.

awaitPromise.description: Wait for promise to resolve if expression returns a promise

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List connected devices and debuggable targets from Metro bundler.

tools.name: get_app_info
tools.description: Get information about the connected React Native app (bundle URL, platform, device name).

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Check the connection status to Metro bundler.

tools.name: reload_app
tools.description: Reload the React Native app. Tries the Metro HTTP endpoint first, falls back to CDP evaluation.

tools.name: symbolicate
tools.description: Symbolicate a stack trace using Metro bundler source maps. Converts minified/bundled locations back to original source files.

stack.description: Array of stack frames to symbolicate

tools.name: get_redux_state
tools.description: Get the current Redux state tree or a specific slice. Works without client SDK if Redux DevTools extension is present or store is exposed globally.

path.description: Dot-separated path to a state slice (e.g., "user.profile")

tools.name: dispatch_redux_action
tools.description: Dispatch a Redux action to the store.

tools.name: get_redux_actions
tools.description: Get recent Redux actions (requires metro-mcp client SDK for real-time tracking).

tools.name: get_component_tree
tools.description: Get the React component tree of the running app. Use structureOnly=true for a compact view (~1-3KB).

structureOnly.description: Return only component names without props/state

tools.name: find_components
tools.description: Search for components by name pattern in the React tree.

pattern.description: Component name or pattern to search for

tools.name: inspect_component
tools.description: Get detailed props, state, and hooks info for a specific component.

tools.name: get_testable_elements
tools.description: Get all elements with testID or accessibilityLabel — useful for test generation.

tools.name: get_storage_keys
tools.description: List all AsyncStorage keys in the React Native app.

tools.name: get_storage_item
tools.description: Read a specific AsyncStorage key value.

tools.name: get_all_storage
tools.description: Dump all AsyncStorage key-value pairs.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot from the connected iOS simulator or Android device.

tools.name: list_simulators
tools.description: List available iOS simulators or Android emulators.

tools.name: install_certificate
tools.description: Install a root certificate on the iOS simulator or Android device.

tools.name: get_native_logs
tools.description: Get native platform logs from iOS simulator (syslog) or Android device (logcat).

filter.description: Filter string (process name for iOS, tag for Android)

lines.description: Number of log lines to return

tools.name: app_lifecycle
tools.description: Launch, terminate, install, or uninstall an app on the simulator/emulator.

tools.name: get_screen_orientation
tools.description: Get the current screen orientation of the device.

tools.name: open_deeplink
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link on the connected iOS simulator or Android device.

url.description: URL or deep link to open (e.g., "myapp://screen/details" or "https://example.com/path")

tools.name: list_url_schemes
tools.description: List URL schemes registered by the app (attempts to detect from the running app).

bundleId.description: Bundle ID to check (auto-detected if not provided)

tools.name: list_permissions
tools.description: List all app permission statuses on the connected iOS simulator or Android emulator. Returns compact text: one name=status line per permission.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: grant_permission
tools.description: Grant a permission to the app on the connected iOS simulator or Android emulator.

service.description: iOS: simctl service (calendar, contacts, contacts-limited, location, location-always, microphone, motion, photos, photos-add, media-library, reminders, siri). Android: runtime permission (e.g. "CAMERA" or "android.permission.CAMERA").

bundleId.description: Bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: revoke_permission
tools.description: Revoke a permission from the app on the connected iOS simulator or Android emulator.

service.description: iOS: simctl service (calendar, contacts, contacts-limited, location, location-always, microphone, motion, photos, photos-add, media-library, reminders, siri). Android: runtime permission (e.g. "CAMERA" or "android.permission.CAMERA").

bundleId.description: Bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: reset_permissions
tools.description: Reset one or all permissions for the app on the connected iOS simulator or Android emulator. On iOS, omitting service resets all services. On Android, omitting service resets all runtime permissions.

service.description: iOS: specific service to reset (e.g. "location"); omit to reset all. Android: permission name (e.g. "CAMERA"); omit to reset all runtime permissions.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: open_app_settings
tools.description: Open the app's system settings page on the connected iOS simulator or Android emulator.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Auto-detected if omitted. Required for Android.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: Get interactive elements from the current screen via the React component tree. Returns labels, testIDs, and roles — use label or testID with tap_element.

interactiveOnly.description: Return only elements with onPress handlers

tools.name: tap_element
tools.description: Tap an element by label, testID, or coordinates. Uses CDP fiber tree, then simctl/adb, then IDB.

label.description: Accessibility label, aria-label, or testID to tap

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into an input field. Targets a specific input by testID/label, or the first visible TextInput. Uses CDP fiber tree, then adb/IDB.

testID.description: testID or accessibilityLabel of the TextInput to target (defaults to first visible input)

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Long press an element by label/testID, or at coordinates. Uses CDP fiber tree, then adb/IDB.

label.description: Accessibility label or testID of the element to long press

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe or scroll in a direction. Tries CDP ScrollView scrollTo, then adb/IDB.

tools.name: press_button
tools.description: Press a device button (HOME, BACK, VOLUME_UP, etc.).

tools.name: get_navigation_state
tools.description: Get the full React Navigation / Expo Router state tree including current route, params, and stack history.

tools.name: get_current_route
tools.description: Get the currently focused route name and params.

tools.name: get_route_history
tools.description: Get the navigation back stack / history.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List all registered route names in the app.

tools.name: audit_accessibility
tools.description: Run a full accessibility audit on the current screen. Checks for missing labels, roles, testIDs, alt text, and more.

tools.name: check_element_accessibility
tools.description: Check accessibility properties of a specific component by name or testID.

tools.name: get_accessibility_summary
tools.description: Quick overview: counts of elements with and without proper accessibility props.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List all custom commands registered by the app. Commands are registered on global.__METRO_BRIDGE__.commands or global.__METRO_BRIDGE_COMMANDS__.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a custom command registered by the app. Pass parameters as a JSON object.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the command

timeout.description: Max ms to wait for async commands (default 15000)

tools.name: start_test_recording
tools.description: Inject interaction interceptors into the running app via the React fiber tree. Captures taps, text entry, long presses, keyboard submits, and scroll/swipe gestures — with no changes to your app code. Works with ScrollView, FlatList, SectionList, FlashList, and other scroll containers. Call stop_test_recording when done, then generate_test_from_recording to get the test.

tools.name: stop_test_recording
tools.description: Stop the active recording, retrieve all captured events, and store them for test generation. Returns a summary of what was recorded. Call generate_test_from_recording next to produce Appium, Maestro, or Detox test code.

tools.name: generate_test_from_recording
tools.description: Convert the most recent recording into a test file. Supports three formats: appium (WebdriverIO + Jest), maestro (YAML), and detox (Jest). Call stop_test_recording first.

testName.description: Name for the test / describe block

bundleId.description: iOS bundle ID or Android app package

tools.name: generate_wdio_config
tools.description: Generate a minimal but runnable wdio.conf.ts for Appium + React Native testing, along with the npm install command.

bundleId.description: iOS bundle ID or Android app package

appPath.description: Path to .app / .apk (leave empty to use a running simulator)

outputPath.description: Shown in the output, not written to disk

tools.name: add_recording_annotation
tools.description: Add a human-readable annotation (comment marker) to the current recording. Useful for labelling major flow checkpoints like "reached checkout", "error appeared here", "navigated to payment". Annotations appear as code comments in generated tests.

note.description: Annotation text to embed in the recording

tools.name: save_test_recording
tools.description: Save the current recording events to disk as JSON so they can be reloaded later. Useful for regenerating the same flow in a different test format without re-recording. Files are saved to ~/.metro-mcp/recordings/<filename>.json.

filename.description: Name for the saved recording (without .json extension)

tools.name: load_test_recording
tools.description: Load a previously saved recording from disk and make it available for test generation. After loading, call generate_test_from_recording with any format to regenerate the test. Use list_test_recordings to see available files.

filename.description: Name of the saved recording (without .json extension)

tools.name: list_test_recordings
tools.description: List all previously saved test recordings in ~/.metro-mcp/recordings/. Returns filenames and sizes. Use load_test_recording to load one for test generation.

tools.name: start_profiling
tools.description: Start profiling the running React Native app. Primary path: injects into the React DevTools hook (__REACT_DEVTOOLS_GLOBAL_HOOK__) via evalInApp — captures all component render durations without requiring <Profiler> wrappers, works on all architectures. Fallback (legacy arch only): CDP Profiler domain for JS CPU call-graph sampling. Perform the interaction you want to measure, then call stop_profiling.

samplingInterval.description: CDP fallback only: sampling interval in microseconds (default 1000).

tools.name: stop_profiling
tools.description: Stop profiling and return an analysis of the captured data. DevTools hook mode: returns top components by total render duration across all commits. CDP mode: returns top JS functions by self time and total time. Must call start_profiling first.

topN.description: Number of top entries to return.

includeNative.description: CDP mode only: include native/internal Hermes frames.

tools.name: get_profile_status
tools.description: Check whether profiling is active, which mode is in use, and whether a previous profile is available.

tools.name: get_flamegraph
tools.description: Return the current profiling results as a human-readable text chart. Shows React DevTools component profile (if captured), CPU flamegraph (if CDP profile captured), and React render data from <Profiler> components (if set up). Call stop_profiling first to populate the profile data.

tools.name: get_react_renders
tools.description: Read React render timing data collected via <Profiler onRender={trackRender}>. Returns all recorded renders sorted by actualDuration descending, with memoization savings from baseDuration. Requires importing trackRender from metro-mcp/client. Use clear=true to reset the buffer.

clear.description: Clear the render buffer after reading.

tools.name: get_memory_info
tools.description: Get current JavaScript heap memory usage from the running app. Returns used heap, total heap, and heap size limit (when available). Call repeatedly to track memory growth over time or to detect leaks.

tools.name: profile_action
tools.description: Profile a specific JavaScript expression or code path in a single call. Starts profiling, evaluates the expression, waits for it to complete (plus optional extra duration), then stops and returns the top functions by self time. Use instead of calling start_profiling / stop_profiling manually for focused measurements.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to profile (can be an async IIFE)

extraMs.description: Additional milliseconds to wait after the expression resolves before stopping (default 0)

topN.description: Number of top functions to return

tools.name: start_heap_sampling
tools.description: Start Hermes heap allocation sampling via CDP HeapProfiler. Records memory allocation call stacks to identify where objects are being allocated. Call stop_heap_sampling to retrieve the top allocation sites.

samplingInterval.description: Average bytes between samples (default 32768). Lower = more detail, higher overhead.

tools.name: stop_heap_sampling
tools.description: Stop heap allocation sampling and return the top allocation sites. Shows which functions are allocating the most memory, useful for diagnosing memory leaks. Must call start_heap_sampling first.

topN.description: Number of top allocation sites to return

tools.name: wait_for_element
tools.description: Poll the component tree until an element matching the given testID or accessibilityLabel appears. Returns element info on success. Use after tap_element, navigate(), or any action that triggers async screen transitions or data loading — instead of immediately calling the next tool.

selector.description: testID or accessibilityLabel to wait for

pollInterval.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default 500)

tools.name: wait_for_condition
tools.description: Poll a JavaScript expression in the app until it returns a truthy value, then return that value. Useful for waiting on state changes, loading flags, API responses, or any async condition. Example: wait for globalThis.myStore?.isLoaded === true.

expression.description: JS expression to evaluate; polling stops when it returns truthy

pollInterval.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default 500)

tools.name: wait_for_navigation
tools.description: Poll the active navigation route until it matches the expected route name, then return. Requires the navigation plugin to be set up (get_current_route must work). Use after tap_element on a link or after dispatching a navigate() action.

routeName.description: Expected route name to wait for (e.g. "HomeScreen", "ProfileTab")

tools.name: setup_statusline
tools.description: Writes the Metro CDP connection status script to ~/.claude/metro-mcp-statusline.sh. Does not modify settings.json — tell the user to add it to their status line themselves (e.g. ask Claude: "/statusline add the script at ~/.claude/metro-mcp-statusline.sh"). Only works with Claude Code.

tools.name: list_debug_globals
tools.description: Auto-discover well-known global debugging objects (Redux stores, Apollo Client, Expo Router, React DevTools hook, etc.) available in the app runtime.

detailed.description: Include top-level keys for each discovered global

tools.name: inspect_at_point
tools.description: Inspect the React component rendered at specific screen coordinates. Walks the React fiber tree to find the component whose layout contains the given point. Experimental: layout measurement varies between Old and New Architecture.

includeProps.description: Include component props in the result

tools.name: open_devtools
tools.description: Open the React Native DevTools debugger panel in Chrome. On RN 0.85+ connects directly to Metro (no proxy needed). On older RN versions connects through the CDP proxy so both DevTools and the MCP can share the single Hermes connection.

open.description: Attempt to open the browser automatically

tools.name: get_app_directories
tools.description: Get known app sandbox directory paths (documents, cache, temp, library). Returns absolute paths usable with list_directory and read_file.

bundleId.description: App bundle ID (iOS, e.g. com.example.app) or package name (Android). Required for iOS; used for Android private-directory resolution.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in an app sandbox path. Call get_app_directories first to obtain the root path.

path.description: Absolute directory path to list. Defaults to the app data container root (bundleId required).

bundleId.description: App bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android). Required when path is omitted; also used for Android run-as access.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the app sandbox. Enforces a configurable size cap (default 50 KB, max 1 MB) to avoid flooding context.

bundleId.description: App package name (Android, for run-as access to private files)

encoding.description: Output encoding. Use base64 for binary files (images, SQLite, etc.)

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to read (default 50 KB, hard cap 1 MB)

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get file or directory metadata: size, modification date, and whether it is a directory.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or directory

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the app sandbox. Requires confirm: true to prevent accidental deletion.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to delete

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm the deletion

tools.name: get_build_info
tools.description: Return build-time and runtime flags for the running React Native app: __DEV__, platform, OS version, RN version, Hermes engine, New Architecture, and expo-application fields if available.

tools.name: get_env_vars
tools.description: Return a filtered subset of process.env from the running app. Credential-like keys (SECRET, KEY, TOKEN, PASSWORD, etc.) are redacted by default. Use filter to search by key name substring.

filter.description: Substring to match against env var key names (case-insensitive)

includeAll.description: When true, includes credential keys that are otherwise redacted

tools.name: get_platform_constants
tools.description: Return the full Platform.constants object from React Native, including OS-specific build details.

tools.name: get_expo_config
tools.description: Return expo-constants manifest/expoConfig fields if the app uses Expo, otherwise null.
